title: Investigation Governance Integration
description: Integrates the Challenge Registry, Question History, Recommendation Registry, and Session Registry into governance review workflows. Provides end-to-end investigative traceability for any question, certification decision, or governance event.

integratedRegistries.description: Tracks challenges (CH-IDs) raised against specific questions during certification or audit
integratedRegistries.governanceIntegration: Links CH-ID → QuestionID → Session → Recommendation. Challenges can trigger governance events (VIOLATION, ESCALATION).

integratedRegistries.description: Per-question timeline: all sessions, certification events, content changes, and defect assignments
integratedRegistries.governanceIntegration: Provides audit trail for any question under governance review. Answers: when was this last certified? who reviewed it? what defects apply?

integratedRegistries.description: Tracks recommendations (REC-IDs) from audit findings to remediation actions
integratedRegistries.governanceIntegration: Links governance events (VIOLATION) to remediation recommendations. Closure of a recommendation can auto-resolve linked governance events.

integratedRegistries.description: Registry of all governance/remediation/certification sessions with deliverables and outcomes
integratedRegistries.governanceIntegration: Provides session-level context for any investigation. Answers: what sessions touched this question? what were the outcomes?

investigationWorkflows.description: When a candidate challenges a question's answer during a practice session
steps: 1. Candidate raises challenge → CH-ID created
2. Challenge linked to QuestionID via challenge_registry.js
3. Audit chain built via certification_audit_builder.js (Board C)
4. Question history consulted via question_history_builder.js
5. Governance guard engine re-verifies the question (Board A)
6. Policy drift detector scans for structural issues (Board B)
7. Resolution recorded in REVISION_HISTORY.md per Rule 1

investigationWorkflows.description: When a governance scan detects a new defect pattern
steps: 1. Governance event created (VIOLATION) via governance_event_registry.js (Board D)
2. Event linked to relevant DL-ID from DEFECT_LIBRARY.md
3. Audit chains built for all affected QIDs (Board C)
4. Recommendation created (REC-ID) via recommendation_registry.js
5. Remediation session assigned and tracked via session_registry_gen.js
6. Post-remediation, governance guard engine re-scans to confirm closure
7. Event status transitioned to CLOSED

investigationWorkflows.description: Before a certification wave, verify no blocked items
steps: 1. Governance guard engine runs all 8 rules (Board A)
2. Policy drift detector scans for structural drift (Board B)
3. Gate -1 identity validation checks all QIDs (Rule 6)
4. Open governance events for target QIDs reviewed (Board D)
5. Recommendation registry checked for outstanding REC-IDs
6. Pre-flight report generated → go/no-go decision

crossRegistryTraceability.description: Any QuestionID can be traced across all four registries
